issue_records.title: toplevel: Fix Revise signature collection
issue_records.body_excerpt:
`report_package` accessed Revise tracking data without synchronization and only populated the first `FileInfo` when one source file was included into multiple modules. It also resolved every signature through JET’s method table, skipping definitions in external method tables.

Collect signature work items and their world age under `revise_lock`, and merge cached analysis results while holding the same lock. Pair source paths with their corresponding `FileInfo` and use the tracked external method table for root lookup when present.
